column1: # The call check's allowlist (callcheck.py): the treatment agents/refactor/reports/20261104-1415-module-map.md section 6 and plan D8 give the calls of the
# hot functions that cross a module boundary. allow: a new call accepted (out of line by design); inline: a callee that must stay inline (header inline or
# static beside its caller), a new call to it being a defect. function '*' is any checked function; a callee may end in '*'; '@cross' is any callee of
# another module than the caller's (with --map). A new call no allow row covers is a defect (D8: single-caller callees on the per-draw and per-binding paths).
